Mechanism hypothesis: the new frontend-proxy container is a single-threaded Perl TCP server that replaces Envoy on port 8080, and the enabled rule WAF_RULE_REGEX='^([a-zA-Z]+)*$' has a nested quantifier that backtracks catastrophically on non-matching input. This is the fault-injection reading of the setting, but I did not capture an actual request_filter_eval line, a stalled request or a 403/timeout, so it remains a hypothesis.

Second mechanism hypothesis (not observed): because the replacement Perl proxy forwards only to FRONTEND_HOST:FRONTEND_PORT (frontend:8080) and no longer runs the Envoy template, the previously proxied non-frontend routes (flagd-ui, grafana, jaeger, locust web, otel-collector, image-provider) would no longer be served through frontend-proxy:8080.

Rejected: product-catalog as root cause. Rejected: a flagd feature-flag fault. All 15 flags in flagd-config have defaultVariant 'off', including cartFailure, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, kafkaQueueProblems and imageSlowLoad, and the product-reviews service logged 'llmRateLimitError feature flag: False'.

Rejected: Kafka or consumer-lag fault. The Kafka cluster reports 0 under-replicated and 0 offline partitions with no offline brokers, and both consumer groups (accounting, fraud-detection) are STABLE.

Rejected: pod crash/OOM/resource-shortage fault. No pod shows a terminated last state, all restartCount values are 0, all containers are ready, and no Evicted event exists; frontend-proxy-88764bfbb-ddd5v itself is Running and ready with 0 restarts.

Counter-evidence against measured impact from the frontend-proxy change inside the window: the load generator's failure counters were still all zero at 2026-11-21T10:58:14Z (locust_requests_num_failures = 0 for every endpoint and for 'Aggregated', with locust_requests_fail_ratio = 0 and 13 total requests in the current window), so no client-visible failure attributable to the new proxy had been recorded by the end of the window.

Advisory: roll the frontend-proxy Deployment back to the previous template (Envoy entrypoint command '/bin/sh -c envsubst < envoy.tmpl.yaml ... && exec envoy -c envoy.yaml', no WAF_RULE_* env, ReplicaSet frontend-proxy-579d54f6f5) or otherwise disable/repair the injected edge request filter (WAF_RULE_ENABLED and the nested-quantifier WAF_RULE_REGEX='^([a-zA-Z]+)*$') under change ticket EDGE-1847, then re-check frontend-proxy request latency, error rate and client (locust) failures.

gaps: The declared fault was not observed happening: no 'request_filter_eval' line with elapsedSeconds > 0, no stalled/blocked request, and no 403/timeout from frontend-proxy were captured. A Loki search for 'request_filter_eval' over 10:50:00-10:58:14Z returned no lines (status no_data), a Loki query for pod frontend-proxy-88764bfbb-ddd5v over 10:57:50-10:58:14Z returned no lines (status no_data), and fetch_pod_logs read 0 bytes/0 lines for that pod's container; those empty results show only that those queries matched nothing.
No frontend-proxy trace spans were returned by Jaeger for 2026-11-21T10:57:58-10:58:14Z (query status no_data), so request latency/status of the new proxy could not be measured.

I could not determine when or by whom the Deployment frontend-proxy pod template was edited: the change_history integration is not available in this Run, and only the ReplicaSet creation (2026-11-21T10:57:54Z) and the rollout events date the change; the origin of the edit is unknown.
There is no pre-change baseline for this application instance: the namespace was (re)created at 2026-11-21T10:56:37Z, so no same-instance latency or error-rate baseline exists.

This Prometheus target exposes no application error/latency series: get_metric_names returned no traces_span_metrics_*, no http_server_request_duration_seconds_count and no rpc_client_duration_* series (only node-exporter, cadvisor, kube-state-metrics, prometheus and locust metrics), so service-level error rates and latency trends are unknown rather than zero.

Whether any client actually sends a 'waf' query parameter is unknown: the locust endpoint list contains only /, /api/cart, /api/checkout, /api/data*, /api/product-reviews/*, /api/products/*, /api/recommendations* and /api/product-ask-ai-assistant/* with no waf parameter.

Client-observed HTTP 500s are known only through the accumulated error list in the locust-fetcher log at 2026-11-21T10:57:50Z; per-request timestamps and which downstream produced them were not available, so their exact cause during bring-up is unconfirmed.
next_steps: Compare the frontend-proxy Deployment/ReplicaSet template against the pre-change ReplicaSet frontend-proxy-579d54f6f5 and confirm with the edge platform team whether change ticket EDGE-1847 (filter-profile managed-rules-v2) was intended in astronomy-shop.

After the window, capture frontend-proxy container logs to look for {"event":"request_filter_eval",...} records with non-zero elapsedSeconds, and measure frontend-proxy request latency/timeouts and client fail_ratio to confirm the ReDoS/blocking behaviour.
Check whether any traffic path sends the 'waf' query parameter to frontend-proxy (ingress, frontend links, external clients) to confirm the canned '200 ok' short-circuit is reachable.
If the Perl filter is to be kept, replace the nested-quantifier rule '^([a-zA-Z]+)*$' with a linear-time validation and make the listener concurrent; otherwise roll back to the Envoy entrypoint.
